sloka: अथ दृष्ट्वा दधिमुखं क्रुद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः ।अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन हनुमत्प्रमुखास्तदा ।। ५.६२.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā dadhimukhaṁ kruddhaṁ vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।abhyadhāvanta vegena hanumatpramukhāstadā ।। 5.62.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Having seen the fury of Dadhimukha, Hanuman the leader of the vanaras went to him swiftly.
